verdict.rationale: Trivy ships a documented, working MCP server (trivy-mcp) that exposes its scanning capabilities to AI agents via JSON-RPC, confirmed by a successful local handshake test, giving AI-native users a genuine programmatic surface. However, there is no traditional REST/OpenAPI public API (all openapi.json/swagger.json paths 404) and no llms.txt, so the 'documented public API' story is only partially met via the MCP plugin rather than a broader API. Missing for 10: a REST/OpenAPI-style public API, llms.txt or other machine-readable API docs, and independent third-party confirmation of the MCP server's reliability at scale.
